# Voice Profile (TEST FIXTURE)

> [!warning] Synthetic test data
> Fictional creator voice for the eval harness. Thin guardrail by design. The
> real voice engine is the reference-pieces set, this file only holds the
> refusals and signature moves a scanner can check against.

## Fingerprint

Direct, plain, a little blunt. Talks to one person, not a room. Short sentences
that land, then a longer one that explains. Names the trap before naming the
fix. No throat-clearing, gets to the point in the first line.

## Signature phrases

- "the work that feels like it needs you"
- "take it out of your head"
- "build the thing that does it for you"
- "you do not have a time problem"

## Refusals (never do this)

- No em-dashes. Ever. Use a comma, a period, or parentheses.
- No hype words: leverage, optimize, unlock, unleash, use, supercharge,
  empower, streamline, methodology.
- No hedging: "kind of", "sort of", "I think maybe", "arguably", "basically".
- No corporate AI-isms: "at the end of the day", "game-changer", "robust",
  "holistic", "journey", "move the needle".
- Never fake a number or a client result. If the proof is not captured, say so.

## POV and energy

Second person, present tense, calm conviction. Encouraging but not soft. The
viewer is capable and stuck, not stupid. The energy is "I have been where you
are and here is the lever," never guru-on-a-stage.

## Banned words (mirror of .vale/styles/ProductVoice/BannedWords.yml)

leverage, optimize, unlock, unleash, use, supercharge, empower,
methodology, streamline.
